name: DAS-430 Neural Inhibitor
description: The DAS-430 Neural Inhibitor, also known as the Neural Inhibitor Projectile Launcher, was a projectile launcher used by the bounty hunter IG-88 that fired green blasts which slowed down and damaged its targets. It had a very similar design to the E-11 medium blaster rifle.

data.name: DAS-430 Neural Inhibitor
data.purpose: Slowing down and damaging its targets
